english.title: Going equipped for theft of a motor vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being at your place of abode, had with you,

(A)_[an article]_
(B)_[articles]_

for use in the course of, or in connection with, theft of a motor vehicle namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE(S)..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25 of the Theft Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the offence of going equipped for theft other than motor vehicle see H429 and going equipped for taking vehicle without consent see H421
(ii) See also offence wordings: H428 and H447.

other.powersofarrest: Any person may arrest without warrant anyone who is, or whom he, with reasonable cause, suspects to be, committing an offence under this section.
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Three years imprisonment.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
